newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixed at lowest since April 1, 1993.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixed at lowest since April 1, 1993.

text.p: Gold bullion fixed at its lowest level since April 1, 1993 of $336.55 per ounce on Friday afternoon down from $337.30 at its 0930 GMT setting this morning.
The fixing brought the bullion price below the year's previous low fix of $336.90 struck on February 12.
On April 1, 1993 gold was fixed at $336.35 as the market entered the rally which took the gold price to a high of $406.70 on August 2.

Dealers attributed Friday's fall -- gold closed in London at $337.90/$338.40 on Thursday -- to a stronger dollar following the United States announcng its highest quarterly gross domestic product data in 10 years.
"There was also some selling by the market professionals early on in the belief that prices would slip lower allowing them to buy back at a profit," one gold dealer said.
The gold price has been under pressure all year from the threat of European central banks selling metal from their reserves to help their countries' meet European Monetary Union financial guidelines.
